mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair progesterone metabolism and increase risk of adverse effects; both agents have potential for hepatic and renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and progesterone efficacy closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation with amphotericin B therapy.
